blocks.text: Bring farmyard fun anywhere, with the Melissa & Doug Wooden Take-Along Sorting Barn. Featuring 10 chunky wooden farm toys—animals like a horse, pig, goat, sheep, chicken, dog, cow, along with a tractor & farmer—all designed to stand upright & fit into shaped cutouts in and around the barn, like jigsaw puzzles. These extra-thick sorting toys are easy to grasp when stacking pieces, and parents will love how these preschool toys blend learning and imaginative play. The barn also has a flip-up roof, so it’s easy to get inside, and a built-in handle for easy transport. For more thrilling role play, combine this with the Melissa and Doug ice cream set, a toy vending machine & a kids kitchen playset to create the ultimate pretend play world! For 35+ years, Melissa and Doug has crafted imaginative preschool toys and durable wooden toys built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from a life-sized grocery store playset to a play kitchen playset and play food to serve plush toys & puppets, to costumes, arts & crafts, and road trip activities for kids. It’s the kind of kid-powered play that builds independence and confidence!

items.label: Farm-Themed Sorting & Stacking Toys
items.value: Fit 10 chunky wooden toys—farm animals, a tractor, and a farmer, into the sorting barn, or stand the wooden animal figures up to create storytelling adventures

items.label: Skill-Building, Montessori Toys
items.value: Enhance preschool learning activities like shape recognition, matching, sorting, learning the names of animals, & problem-solving, with development-focused kids toys

items.label: Portable Wooden Barn Toy
items.value: Pack, carry, & play on the go—kids love the flip-up roof for quick access & toy storage, plus a built-in handle, for taking their screen-free pretend play toys along anywhere

items.label: Educational Toys for Any Occasion
items.value: When buying a birthday gift & holiday gifts for kids, or rewarding little milestones, celebrate the moments that matter with Melissa and Doug toys for boys & girls

items.label: Wholesome Play for 35+ Years
items.value: Melissa & Doug inspires kid-powered play with its learning toys for kids, baby & toddler toys, puzzles, games, building toys & stuffed animals, dolls, & even a doll house

items.label: Included Components
items.value: sorting barn, 10 chunky wooden animal pieces

items.label: Educational Objective
items.value: Animal Recognition, Auditory Perception, Fine Motor Skills, Fine motor Skills, Imaginative Play, Sorting
